text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Mozambican President Joaquim Chissano flew over the flood zones of central Mozambique on Sunday and afterwards decsribed the situation as "catastrophic and pitiful".

- The Save the Children Federation of the USA and the International Network of Landmine Survivors on Sunday offered 3,000 US dollars to the Mozambican Association of the Disabled, ahead of an international conference aimed at rallying support for a ban on landmines, to be held in Maputo from Tuesday to Friday this week.
